acts.1: Meet the people harmed by extraction; earn the crew and the core vocabulary.
acts.2: Return to the people behind those roles; confront complicity, grief and what preservation costs.
acts.3: Change the system without replacing one forced chorus with another; resolve the opening promise.

chapters.title: The Stolen Song
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
FATHER: Brass drives the train.
He leaves a refuge unlocked
beneath the glass viaduct.
Find him. Bring them all home.

chapters.title: The Dawn Carriage
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
BRASS: The drain below this
viaduct reaches Rivens well.
Ask why he signed the tests.
I will help carry the answer.

chapters.title: The Undercity Well
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
RIVEN: I signed their report.
Hesper kept the true account
in the chapel above the drain.
Ask her what Orison erased.

chapters.title: Chapel of Rain
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
HESPER: The bells let me speak.
Mira hid the stolen names
in the archive east of here.
Take my account to her.

chapters.title: Names in the Archive
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
MIRA: These orders bear
Veyrs seal. His office is
above the sky-engine dock.
We need his answer, not a name.
chapters.memory_payoff: The archive exposes ongoing registration of copied voices.

chapters.title: The Sky Engine
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
VEYR: I built it for my child.
Orison made a city feed it.
Corins orchard kept a living
seed. We need another power.

chapters.title: Orchard After Fire
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
CORIN: The seed holds voices
without glass. Take it into
the reactor. Give the city
a choice besides cold or chains.

chapters.title: The Last Reactor
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The Crown was only a mouth.
Lowbank is still losing
children.
Next: Lowbank shelter.

chapters.title: The Children of Lowbank
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
A rescued child carries a work
tag from Brasss second train.
Next: the abandoned train
depot.

chapters.title: The Last Prison Train
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The prisoners and manifest
identify the river flood as a
planned test.
Next: the old flood spillway.

chapters.title: What the River Kept
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The survey lists Subject Seven
as the keeper of the original
names.
Next: the sealed name vault.

chapters.title: A Name Without a Number
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
Mira finds Rooks fathers
address among the collectors
builders.
Next: the unfinished house.

chapters.title: Rook and the Unfinished House
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The apology identifies the
glass chamber where Veyrs
child was recorded.
Next: the glass chamber.

chapters.title: The Daughter in the Glass
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The child remembers a mountain
checkpoint where refugees
vanished.
Next: Sables old checkpoint.

chapters.title: Sable Takes Off the Uniform
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The refugees heard the
mountain relays answer the
checkpoint orders.
Next: the resonance gallery.
chapters.memory_payoff: Sable confronts his courier mark and removes the uniform.

chapters.title: The Mountain Learns a Song
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The answering relays reveal an
observatory watching the whole
network.
Next: the buried observatory.

chapters.title: The Observatory Below the Sky
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The lens shows a stormway and
a settlement losing its heat.
Next: the relief store.

chapters.title: The Price of Warm Rooms
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The settlement can survive,
but its travellers need the
stormway anchors.
Next: the storm anchorage.

chapters.title: A Sky Full of Borrowed Wings
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
Across the stormway, the board
is judging stolen witnesses.
Next: the witness vault.

chapters.title: The Trial of the Witnesses
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The witnesses describe the
clay mold that taught the
network to erase difference.
Next: the first pottery floor.

chapters.title: The Clay That Refused the Mold
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The damaged mold reveals the
intake feeding the Choir with
workers air.
Next: the choir vent house.
chapters.memory_payoff: Recording provenance resolves the impossible date; copying is not resurrection.

chapters.title: Where the Choir Takes Breath
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The workers reveal the
assembly where the city must
choose its next keeper.
Next: the common assembly.

chapters.title: The City Chooses Its Voices
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The city answers before the
Choir can issue its final
command.
Next: the listening chamber.

chapters.title: A Song With No Last Note
chapters.existing_causal_debrief:
The city keeps the voices
without giving one machine the
final word.
Next: Festival Commons.
chapters.memory_payoff: The player chooses the recording’s fate and returns the reed case home.

playtest_hypotheses.first_action: Can a new player name a goal and act within a minute?
playtest_hypotheses.attachment: Can the player explain why Rook and Iona joined without reading external notes?
playtest_hypotheses.mastery: Can the player use the first core, Guard and a supply before seeing the full support vocabulary?
playtest_hypotheses.curiosity: Does the player voluntarily investigate the impossible recording date?
playtest_hypotheses.clarity: Can the player find the next causal lead after returning from a chapter?
playtest_hypotheses.return: Does the player choose to continue or revisit a character after a satisfying resolution?

status: Implemented structure and model tests; player appeal, retention and any optimality claim remain unmeasured.
